articles.headline: Ball scores season-high 34 points as Timberwolves top Bucks 112-100
articles.description: — LaMelo Ball scored a season-high 34 points to lead six players in double figures and the Minnesota Timberwolves pulled away early in the fourth quarter in a 112-100 win over the Milwaukee Bucks on Monday night.
